anime.title: Anime projects
anime.blurb: Shinkai/Ghibli-styled living paintings: a still from FLUX or Wan T2V, ambient motion from Wan 2.2 I2V, looped 9:16 with music. Coastal wildflowers, Torrey Pines, Golden Gate, Mt. Rainier, a cyberpunk street, the FLL farm.

realistic.title: Photoreal projects
realistic.blurb: Cinematic photoreal shorts: FLUX.2 klein stills with Moodboard references, motion from LTX-2.3 or Wan 2.2, Real-ESRGAN to 4K, cut with crossfades. Dragon Epic, Lost City, the three-minute film.

3d.title: 3D-animated projects
3d.blurb: Pixar-style 3D-animated shorts. Kyle's Antarctic Rescue, Lindsey: A Small Dream.
